title: Systemd failed units
description: The systemd-failed-units module displays the number of failed systemd units.

placeholders.description: Number of failed units from systemwide (PID=1) systemd.
Number of failed units from user systemd.
* State of the systemd system session.
* State of the systemd user session.
* Overall state of the systemd and user session. ("ok" or "degraded")

Bulleted list of failed units using tooltip-unit-format. Empty when there are no failed units. This replacement is only available in tooltip-format and tooltip-format-ok; it is not supplied to format/format-ok* and using it there breaks label rendering.
Either system or user depending on where the unit originated

format.label: What to show
format.doc: The format, how information should be displayed. This format is used when other formats aren't specified.
format.description: The text shown in the bar. Words in curly braces, like {icon}, are replaced with live values: see the list of placeholders.

format-ok.label: What to show when ok
format-ok.doc: This format is used when there are no failing units.
format-ok.description: This format is used when there are no failing units.

user.label: User
user.doc: Option to count user systemd units.
user.description: Option to count user systemd units.

system.label: System
system.doc: Option to count systemwide (PID=1) systemd units.
system.description: Option to count systemwide (PID=1) systemd units.

hide-on-ok.label: Hide on ok
hide-on-ok.doc: Option to hide this module when there are no failed units.
hide-on-ok.description: Option to hide this module when there are no failed units.

tooltip-format.label: Tooltip text
tooltip-format.doc: Tooltip format shown when there are failed units.
tooltip-format.description: What the popup shows. It uses the same placeholders as the bar text.

tooltip-format-ok.label: Tooltip when ok
tooltip-format-ok.doc: Tooltip format used when there are no failed units.
tooltip-format-ok.description: Tooltip format used when there are no failed units.

tooltip-unit-format.label: Tooltip unit format
tooltip-unit-format.doc: Format used to render each failed unit inside the tooltip. Each item is prefixed with a bullet.
tooltip-unit-format.description: Format used to render each failed unit inside the tooltip. Each item is prefixed with a bullet.

menu.label: Open popup menu with
menu.doc: Action that pops up the menu.
menu.description: Which click opens a popup menu for this module.

menu-file.label: Menu layout file
menu-file.doc: Location of the menu descriptor file. There needs to be an element of type GtkMenu with id menu
menu-file.description: The file that describes the menu entries (a GTK .xml file with a menu called "menu").

menu-actions.label: Menu commands
menu-actions.doc: The actions corresponding to the buttons of the menu.
menu-actions.description: For each menu entry, the command to run when you pick it.

expand.label: Fill empty space
expand.doc: Enables this module to consume all leftover space dynamically.
expand.description: Stretch the module to use all the free space left in its section.
